t: Powerful and versatile light delivering 7150lm of illumination for large areas available in 2 light modes, full brightness or subtle 50% output. Includes a convenient socket input for onsite power extension, USB-A and USB-C socket entry, foldaway carry handle and suspension hook for transportation. Features durable aluminium die-cast housing and polycarbonate diffuser to withstand tough environments. Ideal for outdoor sites, task lighting, indoor decoration and automotive.
